SQL 防火墙要求强制脱敏的列仍会脱敏；执行时如果你已不是超级用户，会按脱敏设置: Columns the SQL firewall requires to be masked are still masked. If you are no longer a super user when the export runs, it is exported according to the masking settings.
下载失败（HTTP {status}），请稍后重试或联系管理员。: Download failed (HTTP {status}). Try again later or contact an administrator.
不会重试执行，请务必到目标库核对哪些语句已经执行。: It will not be retried. Be sure to check on the target database which statements have already run.
仅在 goInception 无法处理的特殊语句时使用。提交时会在审计里记录“跳: Use only for special statements goInception cannot handle. Submission records “syntax check skipped” in the audit log.
你没有下载这份导出文件的权限。: You do not have permission to download this export file.
你没有提交数据导出工单的权限（缺少 export.submit）: You do not have permission to submit data export workflows (missing export.submit)
你还没有加入任何资源组: You have not joined any resource group yet
关闭后 {name} 不再计入工单成败，也不能再重试；全部实例都被关闭时工单不会: Once closed, {name} no longer counts toward the workflow result and cannot be retried. If every instance is closed, the workflow is not marked as successful.
到 {at} 由调度器自动导出（{executor}）。到点前终止工单会取消计划: The scheduler will export automatically at {at} ({executor}). Terminating the workflow before then cancels the schedule.
到 {at} 由调度器自动执行（{executor}）。到点前终止工单会取消计划: The scheduler will execute automatically at {at} ({executor}). Terminating the workflow before then cancels the schedule.
原工单不是数据导出工单: The original workflow is not a data export workflow
原工单的实例你已无权使用，请重新勾选实例: You no longer have access to the original workflow's instances. Select instances again
原工单的实例已不可选，请重新选择实例: The original workflow's instance is no longer available. Select an instance again
原工单的部分实例已不可选，已勾选其余的: Some of the original workflow's instances are no longer available; the rest have been selected
原数据库「{name}」不在当前实例的库列表里，请重新选择: The original database “{name}” is not in the current instance's database list. Select again
原资源组「{name}」你已不在其中，请重新选择资源组和实例: You are no longer in the original resource group “{name}”. Select a resource group and instance again
取消后工单回到「审核通过」，之后可以重新设置定时或立即执行。: After canceling, the workflow returns to “Approved” and you can set a new schedule or execute it immediately.
如果这张工单是用 goInception 执行的：取消只会断开与 goIncep: If this workflow runs through goInception: canceling only disconnects from goInception; statements already sent to the target database may still be running. Check and terminate them under “Session management”.
审批流读取失败：{msg}: Failed to load the approval flow: {msg}
业务需要查看原值: Business needs to see the original values
导出原值必须填写理由（至少 5 个字），审批人会看到: A reason is required to export original values (at least 5 characters); approvers will see it
导出文件是业务数据（已按数据脱敏配置处理，未配置脱敏的字段是原值），请妥善保管、: The export file contains business data (processed per the masking configuration; fields without masking keep their original values). Keep it safe and do not share it.
导出的文件里是未脱敏的原值，文件流出后无法再控制。: The exported file contains unmasked original values and cannot be controlled once it leaves the system.
将在 {name} 上重新导出，成功后文件合并进同一个压缩包，其余实例的文件不受: The export will run again on {name}. On success the file is merged into the same archive; other instances' files are not affected.
将在 {name} 上重新执行整段 SQL，并用新结果替换它原有的结果行；重试期: The whole SQL will run again on {name} and its previous result rows will be replaced by the new result. The workflow is set to “Executing” during the retry.
将在目标实例上执行导出查询并生成文件。导出开始后无法撤回。: The export query will run on the target instance and generate a file. It cannot be withdrawn once started.
将在目标实例的该库上按顺序执行本工单的 SQL，失败即停，其后语句标为未执行；已: The workflow's SQL will run in order on this database of the target instance. It stops at the first failure and marks later statements as not executed; statements that succeeded are not rolled back automatically. It cannot be withdrawn once started.
工单会变为「执行有异常」，不会自动重试，请到目标库核对实际执行情况。: The workflow becomes “Executed with errors” and will not be retried. Check the actual execution on the target database.
已从工单 #{id} 复制内容，请核对后重新检查并提交。: Copied from workflow #{id}. Review it, then check and submit again.
已按 Redis 上线规则检查: Checked against the Redis go-live rules
已由 SQL Server 语法解析与上线规则检查: Checked by the SQL Server syntax parser and go-live rules
已经成功执行的语句不会回滚；被中断的这一条由目标库回滚（大事务回滚本身也要一段时: Statements that already succeeded are not rolled back; the interrupted one is rolled back by the target database (rolling back a large transaction also takes time).
当前是「{cur}」，不是末级。通过后进入下一级「{next}」继续审批，工单还: The current level is “{cur}”, not the last one. After approval it moves on to “{next}”; the workflow still cannot be executed.
当前是「{cur}」，已是末级审批。通过后工单进入「审核通过」，之后即可执行。: The current level is “{cur}”, the last approval level. After approval the workflow becomes “Approved” and can be executed.
当前账号不能提交批量上线工单，已只带出第一个实例: This account cannot submit batch go-live workflows; only the first instance was carried over
当前账号不能提交批量数据导出工单，已只带出第一个实例: This account cannot submit batch data export workflows; only the first instance was carried over
提交时必须写明理由，审批人会在工单里看到“导出原值”和你的理由，系统审计会留痕。: A reason is required on submission. Approvers will see “Export original values” and your reason in the ticket, and it is recorded in the system audit.
文件不存在，可能已按保留策略清理；需要的话请复制为新工单重新导出。: The file does not exist; it may have been purged by the retention policy. Copy this as a new workflow to export again if needed.
有 {n} 个实例无法使用，请取消勾选或处理后重新检查。: {n} instance(s) cannot be used. Deselect them or fix the problem, then check again.
有 {n} 个实例无法导出，请取消勾选后重新检查。: {n} instance(s) cannot be exported from. Deselect them, then check again.
未配置 goInception，MySQL 实例使用基础检查: goInception is not configured; MySQL instances use the basic check
未配置 goInception，MySQL 实例暂时无法提交: goInception is not configured; MySQL instances cannot be submitted for now
本次下载会写入审计日志（操作「离线下载」，含工单号与文件名）。: This download is written to the audit log (action “Offline download”, including the workflow ID and file name).
检查发现 {n} 个错误，请修改后重新检查。: The check found {n} error(s). Fix them and check again.
检查结果里有 {n} 条警告，请确认已评估过风险。: The check result has {n} warning(s). Make sure the risk has been assessed.
没有可回滚的语句（可能没有产生备份）。: No statements to roll back (no backup may have been created).
登录已过期，请重新登录后再下载。: Your session has expired. Sign in again and retry the download.
目标是生产环境，请输入工单号确认：: The target is a production environment. Enter the workflow ID to confirm:
确定取消这张工单的执行吗？正在执行的语句会被中断，其后的语句不再执行。: Cancel the execution of this workflow? The running statement will be interrupted and later statements will not run.
确定把这张工单标记为「执行有异常」吗？: Mark this workflow as “Executed with errors”?
终止后 gh-ost 会清理影子表，原表不变；该语句记为失败，其后语句不再执行，: After termination gh-ost cleans up the shadow table and the original table is unchanged. The statement is recorded as failed, later statements do not run, and the workflow becomes “Executed with errors”.
终止后不能恢复，需要重新提交。已设置的定时计划会被取消。: Termination cannot be undone; you must submit again. Any schedule already set will be canceled.
该工单只能由目标库原生执行：不备份、没有回滚语句、不支持在线改表。: This workflow can only be executed natively on the target database: no backup, no rollback statements, no online schema change.
该资源组下没有可上线的实例: No instances available for go-live in this resource group
该资源组下没有可导出的实例: No instances available for export in this resource group
该资源组下没有可批量上线的实例: No instances available for batch go-live in this resource group
该资源组下没有可批量导出的实例: No instances available for batch export in this resource group
该资源组还没有配置 SQL 上线审批流，提交会被拒绝。: No SQL go-live approval flow is configured for this resource group; submissions will be rejected.
请先勾选要上线的实例: Select the instances to deploy to first
请先勾选要导出的实例: Select the instances to export from first
请先检查 SQL，通过后才能提交: Check the SQL first; you can submit only after it passes
请先检查查询，通过后才能提交: Check the query first; you can submit only after it passes
请先选择定时执行时间: Select the scheduled execution time first
请填写驳回/终止原因: Enter a reason for rejecting or terminating
请确认你已在线下自行执行完这些 SQL。点击确认后工单标记为已结束，系统不会执行: Confirm that you have already run this SQL yourself offline. After you confirm, the workflow is marked as finished and the system will not execute any statement.
资源组「{name}」的审批流为空：提交后系统直接审核通过，不需要人工审批。: The approval flow of resource group “{name}” is empty: after submission the system approves it directly and no manual approval is needed.
跳过检查后，系统不会发现缺主键、无 WHERE、表不存在等问题。: With the check skipped, the system will not detect problems such as a missing primary key, a missing WHERE clause, or a nonexistent table.
这是批量工单：所有正在执行的实例都会被中断。: This is a batch workflow: all instances currently executing will be interrupted.
驳回后工单进入「人工终止流程」，提交人需修改后重新提交。: After rejection the workflow moves to “Flow terminated manually” and the submitter must revise it and submit again.
没有批量提交的权限: You do not have permission to submit batch workflows
